Marginal notes in the left margin: "II." and "Ab Eccle-siâ Romanâ" beside the first paragraph, "III." and a note on the Augsburg Confession beside the second, "I." and "De Prædestinatione" beside the third. Page number at the top centre. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: II.Ab Eccle-siâ Romanâ[?]clefiam Rom. definivisse hanc controversiam? & ob alterutram harum caufarum: sive propter obscuritatem tantam, ut non posset; si-ve non-necessitatem, ut definiri non deberet?

Quid item vanitatis est, afferere; eam quoque sententiam, proximè exactis sævitiæ temporibus, multorum Martyrum sanguine fuisse signatam? An non hoc testantur Acta Martyrum? An quia non sola signata? Sed hoc nemo affirmat. An quia Thomas consentire dicitur? Quasi novum esset, damnari in nobis eam doctrinam, quæ fuit magistrorum ex ipsismet celeberrimorum. Vide Thomam, part. 1. quæst. 22. & 23.III.à Germani-eâ Ecclesiâ August. Confess. ejusq; autore Melanchthone.

Assumit autem, tertio loco; Ecclesias etiam Germanicas Augustanæ Confessionis, à corpore nostro, ideò, quòd hîc dissentirent, alienas non judicatas esse à viris piis & moderatis. Verùm causa erat; quòd nobiscum pugnarent contra Pontificias corruptelas, pro solâ præsertim Fide justificante, & merâ Gratiâ Dei: etsi, ex parte saltem, rursus negarent, de Prædestinatione nondum plenè intellecta; imò & affingeret nobis

page.notes: Top of the first paragraph is partly damaged: the initial word reads "clefiam" as far as I can see, marked [?]. The word "Verùm" and "imò" keep their printed accents. The original "si-ve" line break has a printed hyphen, kept. No running head is printed on this page. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
